description: Deterministic coding-agent eval tasks. Each task ships its own tiny repository, a scripted model transcript and a post-run verification. No network, no Docker, no live model: the eval runs identically in CI. Schema 1 tasks are the eight C6 tasks (file_contains/command_succeeds over tool and message steps); schema 2 adds the C9 step kind 'check' (a project check at a point in the transcript with the exit status it must report) and the change-set verifications 'test_integrity', 'self_review' (over a RECORDED provider answer) and 'repair_loop', plus 'command_fails' for the negative controls. The additions are additive: every schema-1 task stays valid verbatim.
